hook: Here's how memory actually sticks, in three moves.

points.name: recall
title: Active
Recall
points.line: First, active recall beats rereading every time.
points.explanation: Close the book, write what you remember, then check the gaps you missed.

points.name: spacing
title: Space
Reviews
points.line: Second, space reviews out over days, not hours.
points.explanation: Each review lands just as you start to forget, so the memory comes back stronger.

points.name: mixing
title: Mix
Topics
points.line: Third, mix topics instead of blocking one.
points.explanation: Switching forces your brain to pick the right method, and that choice is what tests reward.

closing: So stop rereading. Recall, space, and mix, and your memory does the rest.
